query:
SELECT
            s.id,
            s.name,
            s.father_name,
            g.name AS grade_name,
            s.admission_no,
            s.date_of_birth
        FROM students s
        JOIN grades g ON s.grade_id = g.id
        WHERE
            ($1::uuid IS NULL OR s.grade_id = $1)
        AND ($2::int IS NULL OR s.admission_no = $2)
        AND (
              $3::text IS NULL
              OR s.name ILIKE '%' || $3 || '%'
              OR s.father_name ILIKE '%' || $3 || '%'
        )
        ORDER BY s.admission_no
        LIMIT $4 OFFSET $5
